test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A condition in which one is unable to sleep over a period of time
solution:
The correct answer is **"Insomnia".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Insomnia **is a common sleep disorder in which a person cannot sleep properly.
 
• In most cases, insomnia is related to poor sleeping habits, depression, anxiety, etc.
 
• **Example - ***My friend suffered from insomnia caused by stress at work.*

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information**

 
• **Sickness** means a feeling of illness or not feeling well.

 
 
• **Example -** *She died from an unknown sickness.*
 
 
 
• **Complaint** means an act of complaining or a statement that you are not satisfied with something.
 
 
• **Example -*** The school received a lot of complaints about the English teacher.*
 
 
 
• **Disorder -** A disturbance of normal functioning of the mind or body.
 
 
• **Example -** *Latika is suffering from panic disorder.*​
